explanation: Push opening brackets on a stack. Each closing bracket must match the most recent opening bracket; the stack must be empty at the end.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C# implementation, reusing and refining the repository-authored Blind75 algorithm fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: The stack lists precisely the unmatched opening brackets in nesting order. A closing bracket is valid exactly when it matches the most recent unmatched opening; popping preserves that invariant. The entire sequence is valid only when every close matches and the stack ends empty.
walkthrough: For "{[()]()}", push {, [, (. The next ) and ] remove their matching tops. A later () pair also cancels, and the final } removes the initial {. The empty stack proves true.
edgeCases: A closing bracket cannot appear before its matching opening.
Nested pairs must close in reverse opening order.
An empty bracket string is valid.
